title: VeriMath: Human-in-the-Loop Generation and Verification of Curriculum-Aligned Mathematics Assessment Items
abstract: arXiv:2611.23456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic generation of mathematics assessment items is a growing area in educational artificial intelligence, yet classroom deployment remains challenging. Generated questions must satisfy multiple constraints: mathematical correctness, curriculum alignment, appropriate cognitive difficulty, and educator reviewability. While prior work has advanced text generation, reliable assessment authoring requires granular control over localized examination formats and expert educational judgment. To address this challenge, we present VeriMath, a generalized, human-in-the-loop framework for generating rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts. Using annotated reference items, the framework anchors generation to the requested examination section and cognitive reasoning level, then applies sequential automated verification and guided repair before submitting drafts for expert review. translated_title: VeriMath：基于人在回路的课程对齐数学评估题目生成与验证
translated_abstract: 数学评估题目的自动生成是教育人工智能中一个日益发展的领域，然而在课堂中的实际部署仍然充满挑战。生成的题目必须满足多重约束条件：数学正确性、课程对齐性、适当的认知难度，以及教育者可审阅性。尽管先前的工作在文本生成方面已取得进展，但可靠的评估题目编写需要对本地化考试格式的精细控制以及专业的教育判断。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了VeriMath，一个通用的、人在回路的框架，用于生成严谨的、受课程约束的数学评估题目草稿。该框架利用带标注的参考题目，将生成过程锚定到所要求的考试章节和认知推理水平，随后应用顺序化的自动化验证与引导式修复，再将草稿提交给专家审阅。我们通过一个国家课程……（摘要截断）
tldr: VeriMath提出了一个通用的人在回路框架，通过以带标注的参考题目为锚点约束考试章节与认知推理水平，并结合顺序化自动验证、引导式修复和专家审阅，生成严谨且符合课程要求的数学评估题目草稿。
en_tdlr: VeriMath is a generalized human-in-the-loop framework that generates rigorous, curriculum-constrained mathematics assessment drafts by anchoring generation to annotated reference items' exam sections and cognitive levels, applying sequential automated verification and guided repair, and submitting results for expert review.
